name: Image Toolkit
description: Image workbench: compress with target-size binary search, crop, resize, rotate and flip, convert PNG/JPEG/WebP/AVIF, export batches as ZIP, add watermarks, adjust filters, inspect image information and EXIF, and read or write workspace images. Includes four AI tools for workspace images.

build.command: npx --no-install esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=es2022 --packages=external --outfile=index.mjs && npx --no-install esbuild src/client.ts --bundle --platform=browser --format=esm --target=es2022 --loader:.css=text --external:./vendor/* --outfile=client/entry.mjs
